Due to this type of toilets I am not able to pass the urine in sitting positin bcos it is very ugly(due to non-muslims are also used). Question: Assalamualikum mufti Sb., Mostly in our Office western type of toilets are there. Due to this type of toilets I am not able to pass the urine in sitting positin bcos it is very ugly(due to non-muslims are also used). In this moment I am in the position to pass the urine in standing position only, kindly confirm what I should do during this situation. Awaiting your earlier response to bring in my life accordingly. Answer ID: 10836 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 303/237=H/1430) If, in your environment, there is no way to urinate in sitting position, then in the state of compulsion you are allowable to pass urine in standing position. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
